name: Cheryl L. Alsandor
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Houston, Texas
about: Cheryl L. Alsandor is an attorney who represents clients in the Houston, Texas area. Cheryl Alsandor is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2018 - 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Cheryl Alsandor chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. She attended University of Houston Law Center and graduated in 1998. Cheryl Alsandor passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1998.
She represents clients with Family Law issues in Texas.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Cheryl Alsandor has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
